entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Sarah at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Could I please have your order number to pull up your account?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloPro cycling shoes, delivered on January 20th. To make sure I handle this correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
They're terrible. I went for one ride and they gave me blisters on my heels.

Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Just to confirm, were the cleats installed and positioned correctly? Sometimes a minor adjustment there can make a world of difference in comfort.
The cleats are fine. It's the shoes. I just want to send them back.
Of course, I understand. Not a problem at all. Since you're well within the 90-day return window for our cycling shoes, I can process a full refund for you right away.
Fine. What do you need me to do?

I've just initiated that return for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label now. Simply pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Whatever. As long as it's done.
It is. You should see that email in the next few minutes. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for your call, and I hope we have an opportunity to serve you better in the future. Have a good day.
